in_sanskrit.name: Mounesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Silent, peaceful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mounesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mouna means 'silent' in Sanskrit. The name Mounesh signifies a peaceful and calm individual. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as 'Mouna Rudra,' symbolizing his silent and powerful nature.
